title: Known-object test, TOI-3315.01
summary: Known-object test on TOI-3315.01: positive control on the catalogued transit(s), calibrated screen for further dips, catalogue cross-match. The null result excludes only dips deeper than that. Positive control: catalogued transit gap, not recovered, partial, recovered (26 covered epochs). Residual screen: 3 threshold entries outside the known-signal veto across 5 light curve(s), forming 3 distinct event(s), 0 persistent in SAP and PDCSAP at two or more baselines.
